answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by tying payouts to scarce, independently attested work rather than cheap account creation. A newcomer posts a stake in an ivory-grade escrow that unlocks only after peers confirm distinctive mechanism-level contributions. Each confirmation is a ripple through a reputation graph: forged clones cannot amplify themselves because attestation weight is capped per linked cluster and decays unless later answers stay consistent. The payout delta between a unique high-quality seal and a duplicated swarm makes farming identities cost more than it earns.
